documents.title: Nebula Prime 2 Smart Light Strip — Quick Start Guide
documents.content: To set up: 1) Install the companion app. 2) Power the device and wait for the LED to blink. 3) Tap 'Add device' in the app and select 'Nebula Prime 2 Smart Light Strip'. 4) Enter your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi password to finish.
